title: A note on the self-intersection of rational unicuspidal curve with one Puiseux pair
summary: For any $(p,q)$, we proved the existence of a rational unicuspidal curve with one Puiseux pair $(p,q)$ in an algebraic surface, with a self-intersection which realizes the upper bound $m_{p,q}$ conjectured by the first-named author in \cite{C}, thus strengthening the symplectic version of the result in \cite{C}. These ``optimal" curves were obtained by examining two infinite families of rational bicuspidal curves, one in $CP^2$ and one in $CP^1\times CP^1$.
